test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 12 Mar 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: If Rs. 12,000 becomes Rs. 15,000 at simple interest in 5 years, then find the rate of interest per annum.
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = Rs. 12,000

Amount (A) = Rs. 15,000

Time (T) = 5 years

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = A - P

Rate of Interest (R) = (SI × 100) / (P × T)

**Calculation:**

Simple Interest (SI) = Rs. 15,000 - Rs. 12,000

SI = Rs. 3,000

Rate of Interest (R) = (3,000 × 100) / (12,000 × 5)

⇒ R = 300,000 / 60,000

⇒ R = 5%

**The rate of interest per annum is 5%.**
